group.title: Adapter selection guide
group.passage:
Adapter guide for field technicians

Model R10: one wired network port; no USB-A port; no charging pass-through; 45 g.
Model R20: one wired network port and one USB-A port; charging pass-through up to 60 W; 70 g.
Model R30: two wired network ports and one USB-A port; charging pass-through up to 90 W; 110 g.

All three models connect to a compatible USB-C port on the laptop. Technicians who need to charge the laptop through the adapter must choose a model with charging pass-through. For laptops requiring more than 60 W, select R30. Charging cables and power supplies are sold separately.

The purchasing team recommends choosing the lightest model that meets the task requirements rather than automatically selecting the model with the most ports.
group.passageZh:
現場技術人員轉接器指南

R10：一個有線網路埠；沒有 USB-A 埠；不支援充電直通；45 g。
R20：一個有線網路埠及一個 USB-A 埠；充電直通最高 60 W；70 g。
R30：兩個有線網路埠及一個 USB-A 埠；充電直通最高 90 W；110 g。

三種型號都接到筆電相容的 USB-C 埠。需要透過轉接器替筆電充電者，必須選有充電直通的型號。筆電若需超過 60 W，請選 R30。充電線及電源供應器另售。

採購團隊建議選擇能滿足工作需求的最輕型號，不必一律選埠數最多的型號。
